queueRecovery.titleBusy: Older leftovers besides the current generation
queueRecovery.titleIdle: A generation queue can be recovered
queueRecovery.bodyBusy_one: There is already {{count}} generation in progress. These leftover jobs are from a previous shutdown, not the clip decoding now. Resuming them queues them behind and reruns them from scratch.
queueRecovery.bodyBusy_other: There are already {{count}} generations in progress. These leftover jobs are from a previous shutdown, not the clip decoding now. Resuming them queues them behind and reruns them from scratch.
queueRecovery.bodyIdle_one: HocusPocus saved {{count}} job before closing. You can resume them in the same order or discard them and start with an empty queue.
queueRecovery.bodyIdle_other: HocusPocus saved {{count}} jobs before closing. You can resume them in the same order or discard them and start with an empty queue.
queueRecovery.duplicateWarning: Do not press Resume if Activity already shows an H3 in sampling/decode: that duplicates the GPU. Discard leftovers and let the live job finish.
queueRecovery.rerunWarning: The clip that was running will start again from the beginning; waiting clips keep their order.
